thread_lock_contention.safety_guarantee: Prevents native C++ access violation (0xC0000005) in FPDF_LoadPage font cache
thread_lock_contention.architectural_recommendation: Multi-threaded in-process rendering is serialized by PDFIUM_LOCK to guarantee native C++ safety. For true horizontal multi-core throughput scaling without lock contention, production deployments must employ a multi-process architecture (ProcessPoolExecutor / separate worker container instances).

multiprocess_scaling.runtime_isolation: Process-isolated PDFium C++ font caches without mutex lock contention

workload_specification.mathematical_reconciliation: R_warm * T_warm = N and R_wall * T_wall = N confirmed across all worker configurations

monetary_recognition_root_causes.mechanism: Bicubic downscaling into DeiT 384x384 patch size (16x16 tokens) blurs isolated 2x2 period pixels; language model decoder predicts number continuation without decimal.
monetary_recognition_root_causes.safe_remediation: Safe financial normalizer detects malformed 5-digit groupings (',22000') and abstains from execution (ValidationStatus.AMBIGUOUS), routing to human review.

monetary_recognition_root_causes.mechanism: Language decoder bias favors unformatted numeric literals over punctuation.
monetary_recognition_root_causes.safe_remediation: Safe normalizer parses integer and fractional components preserving raw evidence and decimal value without destructive string manipulation.

monetary_recognition_root_causes.mechanism: Visual similarity in low-resolution font renders triggers autoregressive substitution.
monetary_recognition_root_causes.safe_remediation: Safe normalizer cross-references document-level ISO currency codes and triggers ValidationStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW if conflicting currencies detected.

monetary_recognition_root_causes.root_cause: Table Column Gutter Fragmentation in Dense Schedules
monetary_recognition_root_causes.mechanism: Pure XY-Cut projection profiles fragment irregular tabular lines.
monetary_recognition_root_causes.safe_remediation: TableStructureExtractor introduces horizontal overlap clustering and cell adjacency modeling.
